# uptimecheck_status_page (Resource)

A public status page: its look and the monitors it shows. The password, the email access list and custom CSS are set in the app and left alone here. Deleting it deletes its subscribers, written updates and visitor statistics.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimecheck_monitor" "site" {
  type   = "http"
  name   = "Website"
  target = "https://example.com"
}

resource "uptimecheck_status_page" "public" {
  title       = "Example status"
  description = "Our website and API."
  components = [
    { monitor_id = uptimecheck_monitor.site.id, name = "Website", group = "Public" },
  ]
}

output "status_page_url" {
  value = uptimecheck_status_page.public.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) The page's heading, at most 80 characters.

### Optional

- `accent_color` (String) Hex color, e.g. #1F5CFF (the default).
- `announcement` (String) A notice at the top of the page.
- `components` (Attributes List) The monitors on the page, in the order visitors see them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--components))
- `description` (String) A line under the title.
- `language` (String) The language visitors and subscribers see the page in (default en).
- `logo_url` (String) An https:// image shown instead of the title.
- `noindex` (Boolean) Ask search engines not to list the page.
- `project_id` (String) The project (client) it belongs to.
- `published` (Boolean) false takes the page offline without deleting it.
- `show_branding` (Boolean) false removes "Powered by Uptimecheck" (paid plans).
- `show_response_times` (Boolean) Each component also shows its average response time and a 24-hour line.
- `slug` (String) The address after /s/. Only plans with custom addresses may choose it; left out, it comes from the title when the page is created.
- `theme` (String) auto (follows the visitor, the default), light or dark.
- `website_url` (String) An https:// link back to your site.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The status page's id (sp_…).
- `url` (String) The public address.

<a id="nestedatt--components"></a>
### Nested Schema for `components`

Required:

- `monitor_id` (String) The monitor shown (mon_…).
- `name` (String) What visitors see.

Optional:

- `group` (String) Components with the same group fold under it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A status page is imported by its id.
terraform import uptimecheck_status_page.public sp_...
```
